profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary:
Embedded Software Engineer with a strong background in software design, development and verification.

Specialties: Familiarity with Motorola 68000 families, AMD 29000, LSI 64901, MIPS 3940, Z80/180 and Intel 8051 families of microprocessors, VxWorks/Tornado, SUN-OS, HP-UX, Concurrent OS32, Logic/Spectrum Analyzers, ARINC 429, MIL-STD 1553, In-Circuit Emulator(Step Engineering, Orion, HMI, ICE592, ICE51) and other various lab equipments. 

Programming skills in various assembly language, C, C++, Ada, Visual Basic, FORTRAN, CLIST, JCL, PL/1, HPVEE and National Instruments Labview package.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Design, development, integration and testing of 3-D Virtual Maintenance Trainers (VMT) for US Navy P8 Poseidon. Develop simulation includes software architecture, requirements, interfaces, software verification plans, test procedures and test environments. Executing the test procedures and documenting results to ensure software system requirements are met. Using C++, XML with Visual Studio, Eclipse, VMWare, Linux, Object-oriented software development and Rhapsody design. Configuration management using Agile technology, Version One, GIT, ClearQuest/ClearCase and Sherlock.

Accomplishments: Successfully developed and delivered Virtual Maintenance Trainer(VMT) simulation for Canadian CH-147 program.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Develop software verification plans, test procedures and test environment for Space Shuttle Multifunction Electronic Display Subsystem (MEDS), executing the test procedures and documenting test results to ensure software system requirements are met. Develop in various software programming language (C, Assembly ADA, JCL, CLIST and PL/1) for the IBM, AP-101S GPC (General Purpose Computer). Develop and maintain a database in Microsoft Access to record all team member activities. Maintain the post processing tools for Backup Flight software. Perform complete software life cycle including Design, Code, Test, and initiate all associate IPTRs. Other activities include perform DR analysis, initiate SCR, SPCR, and conduct technical presentations at CCB. 
 
Accomplishments: Successfully completed software transition of the post processing tools for Backup Flight software from Huntington Beach, CA to Houston, while providing full supports to ongoing RTF efforts; presented comprehensive SSP technical presentation at the SSP Software Qualification Board as part of the competency certification process for the SSP software development.
 
Successfully developed an application in Visual Basic for converting computer graphics files from IBM format into Microsoft Word documents and automated generating a final report to submit to customer (USA/NASA). The application cuts down the process from several hours to 15 minutes of generating a report.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:  Develop firmware in C and Assembly language for Satellite modems. Develop software for user interface and communication protocol for Up/Down converters. Develop both software and DOS application to upgrade firmware of Satellite modem via RS-232/RS-485 serial port and VME-1553 bus.Develop in various programming languages (Perl script, C, HP VEE and Labview) for system validation and Automated Test Software for production. Perform entire software life cycle which include design software from requirements, create unit test stations, capture and archive test results, create test and hardware setup procedures. Design, develop, prototyping, testing and debugging entire products in all phases of production.

Accomplishments:  Successfully completed, on schedule the entire series products.  Deliver products on promises and ahead of schedule for customer integration testing.

Successfully found software glitch in communication protocol from vendors.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Develop microdrivers in C and Assembly language for network devices. Design and develop user interface tasks to control user privilege admission login from local port (UART) and process the request commands to the network device.

Accomplished: Sucessfully Developed API primitive microdrivers for network device and user interface task to control user privilege admission to log into network. Implement in C using VxWorks/Tornado on NT platform.

Develop Perl scripts to test primitive microdrivers with simulation.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Develop firmware in C and Assembly language for public phone system. Develop low level standard I/O library, drivers for C calling and stand alone software for system diagnostics.
 
Accomplishments: Developed in Visual Basic, Microsoft Access and Assembly language for AVTS (Automatic Validation Testing System).

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Develop software application in Fortran for Lottery system. Develop firmware in C and Assembly language for lottery terminals.

Accomplishments: Successfully completed, on schedule and budget. Deliver products on promises and ahead of schedule for customer integration testing.

Successfully deliver the first Powerball lottery goes on line for Arizona State.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Develop firmware in C, C++ and Assembly languages for Reading machines and scanners.  Develop low level standard I/O library, drivers for C calling and stand alone software for system diagnostics. Develop software user interfaces and protocol communication for Reading machines and scanners.

Accomplishments:  Successfully complete testing and delivers on schedule for the entire products.
